traceability.notes:
This story is clearly a specification (not a planning-only doc), and most of its requirements are implemented and covered by unit and rule-level tests: - Dual-position detection for else-if annotations (before-else and between condition/body) is implemented in gatherElseIfCommentText and verified by tests in tests/utils/branch-annotation-else-if-position.test.ts. - Position priority (before-else annotations taking precedence when both positions exist) is implemented and tested. - Auto-fix behavior for else-if branches with BlockStatement consequents is adjusted so comments are inserted inside the block where Prettier will preserve them, verified by tests/utils/branch-annotation-else-if-insert-position.test.ts and the require-branch-annotation rule tests. - Prettier compatibility is further exercised by an integration test suite that formats code with Prettier and then lints it; however, these tests are currently skipped by default unless an environment variable is set.
However, at least one explicit requirement and acceptance criterion is not fulfilled: - The story defines REQ-SINGLE-LINE-ELSE-IF-SUPPORT and explicitly leaves the corresponding acceptance criterion (Single-Line Support) unchecked. There is no traceability annotation, implementation-specific handling, or dedicated test targeting this requirement in the repository. - While the existing logic may incidentally handle some single-line cases via before-node comments, there is no concrete evidence (tests or explicit code/support requirement) that the plugin supports the real-world single-line else-if pattern described in the story (especially with @supports annotations), nor that this was intentionally validated.
Because not all acceptance criteria in the story are demonstrably satisfied—specifically Single-Line Support (REQ-SINGLE-LINE-ELSE-IF-SUPPORT)—the implementation of this story is only partially complete. Therefore the correct assessment is FAILED rather than PASSED.
